notes.title: New Event Story "Highlander Railroad Runaway Incident" Update
notes.content: [p align="justify"][b]Event Story - Highlander Railroad Runaway Incident: And the Train Disappeared[/b][/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/443c27b9-10a1-4e4c-9171-98e4e851f0da/BA%ED%95%98%EC%9D%B4%EB%9E%9C%EB%93%9C%EC%B2%A0%EB%8F%84%ED%8F%AD%EC%A3%BC%EC%82%AC%EA%B1%B4%EC%BB%A4%EB%AE%A4%EB%8B%88%ED%8B%B0780x440EN.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]🔹 [b]Event Schedule[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Event Schedule: 9/23 (Tue) After Maintenance – 10/7 (Tue) 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p align="justify"]- Shop, Task, Mini Game, and Event Reward Claim and Exchange Schedule: 9/23 (Tue) After Maintenance – 10/14 (Tue) 1:59 AM (UTC)[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]🔹 [b]Event Details[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Clear Mission 2-3 (Normal) to participate in the "Highlander Railroad Runaway Incident: And the Train Disappeared" event.[/p][p align="justify"]- The Event Story includes content such as battles, episodes, Quests, and Challenges, as well as reward-related menus like the Prize Exchange, Shop, and Tasks.[/p][p align="justify"]- Sweeps can only be used in Quests.[/p][p align="justify"]- You can get additional repeat rewards by clearing with Specialized Effect Students.[/p][p align="justify"]* After the event period, unused event currencies will be converted to Credit Points, at a 1:1 ratio, and sent to your mailbox.[/p][p align="justify"]* Please check in-game for further details.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]Story[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Clear Story episodes to earn various rewards, like Pyroxenes and event currency.[/p][p align="justify"]   ㄴ Clear Story – 01 Central Control Center Planning Office, to get Aoba (1★).[/p][p align="justify"]- Once you clear the event story, you can re-watch unlocked episodes in the Story menu.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/46d17aef-59fd-4fd7-866f-fac184d6f7d2/image.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]Quests[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Clear Quests to earn various rewards like Credit Points and Artifacts.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/4ab1862d-6ecb-4afe-9061-237194fad598/image.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]Challenges[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Challenges open 9/23 (Tue) 7:00 PM (UTC).[/p][p align="justify"]- Event Challenges only have 3★ and First Clear Rewards. Clearing Challenges more than once will not grant additional rewards.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/267efbe5-dd71-4b93-93f2-4a6bfb52411d/image.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]Tasks[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Clear Event Tasks to earn rewards like Titles, Credit Points, Pyroxene, and Secret Tech Notes.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/71b411b5-1860-496f-911f-0dadfe831b57/image.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]Specialized Student Effects[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Specialized Students grant bonuses for each event currency.[/p][p align="justify"]ㄴ In the event screen, go to Specialized Students → Event Currency to view the details.[/p][p align="justify"]- The Specialized Effect applies to stages in both Story and Quests.[/p][p align="justify"]- Specialized Effects only apply to repeat rewards.[/p][p align="justify"]- Once a Specialized Effect is applied, it remains permanently applied to that stage. The effect also applies to Sweeps.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/6d3120f7-60ed-432b-8ed0-1220fccb4ab7/EventPlayGuide8461En.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/f2b88bf8-7990-4c30-a0bb-06a17b47e0bb/EventPlayGuide8462En.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/eee3ffbf-93ef-4182-ada5-4c757a4eaff9/EventPlayGuide8463En.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]Shop[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Currencies you earn from Story and Quest stages can be traded for items in the event shop.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/d9d8be37-0f53-4161-ae61-5ada45902471/EventPlayGuide8464En.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]Mini Game[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Use Highlander Stickers to play the puzzle-based railroad construction mini game.[/p][p align="justify"]- Trains run once a single track connects the departure, layover, and arrival stations.[/p][p align="justify"]- Earn rewards by placing tracks on their optimal routes and running the train.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]1) How to Place Tracks[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Place your "Current Track" on an empty tile.[/p][p align="justify"]  * The set number of "Current Tracks" will be randomly designated. This cannot be changed.[/p][p align="justify"]- Use the Rotate button to change the direction of the "Current Track."[/p][p align="justify"]- Use the Check button to place "Highlander Stickers" and position the "Current Track" in a certain direction.[/p][p align="justify"]- Starting from round 7, you can press the Skip button to skip track placements.[/p][p align="justify"]* Skipping will obtain all available round rewards.[/p][p align="justify"]* Skipping will consume the number of Highlander Stickers otherwise needed to place tracks on the remaining empty tiles.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/b6341739-b677-46d5-82b9-25716a047381/EventPlayGuideMiniGameRoad8462En.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/09d2087e-72bd-4830-ae85-0d3e741695cf/EventPlayGuideMiniGameRoad8463En.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"][b]2) How to Change Tracks[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- Once placed, tracks can be moved or rotated without consuming additional currency.[/p][p align="justify"]* Select a placed track to swap it to an empty or placed track space. You can also rotate it.[/p][p align="justify"]* Departure, Layover, and Arrival stations cannot be moved or rotated.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/3848ad4e-cfa3-425e-a538-4ca5c16f2050/EventPlayGuideMiniGameRoad8464En.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]3) How to Run the Train[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- After placing tracks and connecting Departure, Layover, and Arrival stations, the "Start Train" button will become available.[/p][p align="justify"]  * On certain maps you can activate the "Start Train" button without placing tracks on all available tiles.[/p][p align="justify"]- Press the "Start Train" button to run the train. A speed control lever will appear at bottom right of the screen.[/p][p align="justify"]- Use the speed control lever to change the speed of the train.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/ec528363-b45f-4e2f-8d1d-7e3ce55e583b/EventPlayGuideMiniGameRoad8461En.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]4) Train Rewards[/b][/p][p align="justify"]- The round ends once the train reaches the Arrival station. Round rewards and bonus rewards will then be available.[/p][p align="justify"]* You can only obtain bonus rewards that are on the train's route.[/p][p align="justify"][img src="https://dszw1qtcnsa5e.cloudfront.net/community/20250918/adf085ad-ae90-409e-9c38-395764fdf858/EventPlayGuideMiniGameRoad8465En.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: [STEAM Client Release Celebration Event] Doki Doki Heart Milestone Event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45643295/ce4b0731508a809e72c83e66cf480c7c2159802f.png[/img]
Sensei! In celebration of Blue Archive's STEAM release, we are introducing the Doki Doki Heart Milestone Event!
Whenever the number of people who added Blue Archive to their wishlist on the STEAM store page reaches a milestone, various gifts will be delivered to Sensei! 💙
 
Add Blue Archive to your wishlist, and don't miss out on the generous rewards!
 
[b]🔹 Event Schedule[/b]
- 6/2 (Mon) – Until the Official Steam Launch
 
[b]🔹 Event Details[/b]
- Get event gifts that accumulate whenever the number of people who added Blue Archive to their wishlist on the Steam store page reaches another milestone.

[table]
    [tr]
        [th]Goal[/th]
        [th]Event Gift[/th]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]25,000[/td]
        [td]Advanced Activity Report x50
Superior Activity Report x20
[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]50,000[/td]
        [td]Beginner Tech Notes Choice Box x25
Normal Tech Notes Choice Box x20
Advanced Tech Notes Choice Box x15
[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]75,000[/td]
        [td]Expert Permit x4,000[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]100,000[/td]
        [td]10-Recruitment Ticket x1[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
* Event rewards will be distributed after the official Steam launch.
* Details regarding reward distribution will be announced later via a separate notice.

[b]❗ Notes ❗[/b]
∙ We will inform you through the notice if any changes occur.
∙ This title includes suggestive content and mature themes that may not be suitable for all age groups. Access may be limited based on the user's age.
